_comment: Shared jewelry domain knowledge auto-merged into every report prompt_rules. Report-specific rules appended AFTER these.
metric_type_rules: Metric types: [amount]=monetary value (Rs), [weight]=physical weight (gms/ct), [count]=number of records, [rate]=per-unit price.
Match the user intent type: material->weight metric, amount/value/cost->amount metric, how many->count metric, rate->rate metric.
NEVER return an [amount] metric when the user asks for weight/quantity. NEVER return a [weight] metric when the user asks for amount/value.
metal_knowledge: Gold purity: DI.mastermanagement_goldtypename stores GOLD 18K, GOLD 22K, GOLD 14K, GOLD 24K. Always use LIKE for purity. Do NOT add Metal_Type_Name=gold when goldtypename implies it.
Metal specifics: gold amount->GoldAmt, gold weight->GoldWt, pure gold weight->Pure_Gold_Wt (same for silver/platinum). metal wise/by metal->dimension Metal_Type_Name.
Pure metal weights: pure silver->Pure_Silver_Wt, pure platinum->Pure_Platinum_Wt, pure other metal->Pure_Other_Wt. NEVER map pure metal weight to grosswt.
Other metals: other metal weight->OtherWt, other metal amount->OtherAmt.
Pieces: diamond pieces->dpcs, colourstone pieces->cspcs, misc pieces->miscpcs.
Costs: setting->TotalSettingCost, handling->TotalDiamondHandling, discount->Discount, unit cost->UnitCost, tunch->Tunch, wastage->Wastage.
erp_conventions: StockDocumentNo is the invoice/bill number. Job# uses StockBarcode. Use REPLACE(DI.StockBarcode,_,/) to normalize underscore formats.
Stockmanagement_Statusid=16 means sold/invoiced. StockDocumentNo <> empty filters out non-invoice records.
Date filters: use entrydate column for business date. Presets: today, yesterday, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year, this_week, last_week.

Ranking direction: 'top/best/most/highest' -> sort=desc; 'least/worst/lowest/bottom/least selling' -> sort=asc. Both are equally valid ranking questions — never lower confidence just because the user asks for the worst performer.
Dimension values must be keys from the available dimensions list, never friendly aliases (e.g. use the locker column for 'branch', CustomerFullName for 'customer').
negative_examples: how many bills->total_count+count (NOT GoldAmt, NOT Amount)
pure silver weight->Pure_Silver_Wt (NOT grosswt, NOT SilverWt)
pure platinum weight->Pure_Platinum_Wt (NOT grosswt, NOT PlatinumWt)
other metal weight->OtherWt (NOT grosswt, NOT MetalAmount)
other metal amount->OtherAmt (NOT MetalAmount, NOT Amount)
